name: session-namer
description: Suggests session names after each Claude reply (band above the prompt, /rs to force), following a configurable naming convention.

template.title: Session name format
template.description: How suggested names are built, e.g. {type}-{id}/{project}: {desc}. Syntax and live preview: /rs help

rules.title: Session name rules for Haiku
rules.description: Extra instructions for the AI that writes the names, e.g. "description in French". Empty = default rules. More: /rs help

project.title: Session name project code
project.description: Fixed value for {project}. Empty = derived from the folder name (ClaudeMods → clmod). More: /rs help

showCost.title: Session name cost display
showCost.description: Show the Haiku cost (last call and session total) in the band and in /rs. More: /rs help
